title: Build the canonical six-node City Board with public operational player cards
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Render minimal City Board from the approved public view: active incident/city, Repair0..6/Sabotage0..6 tracks, round, current rotating Shift Lead, authoritative remaining-time display and alias/avatar cards. Cards show only operational status Shift Lead/Repair Crew/Eligible/Cooldown/Jammed/Disconnected as allowed, never secret faction. Keep details in blocking sheets and one appropriate primary lead action; other players receive a concrete waiting state. Local clock may display a deadline but cannot rotate lead, resolve a vote or advance a round. Preserve six-node semantics without altering the old five-mark BoardView. Expressive city/card effects may be full colour; labels/icons also carry status. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props. The canonical producer contracts are A025 observeMatchV1/getLegalActionsV1 and A056 versioned recipient DTOs (A067 projects multiplayer views); public/private/legal fields must originate there, never raw hidden MatchStateV1. A004 owns exact I01–I06 option labels and all36 semantic icon keys.
acceptance: All six Repair/Sabotage nodes and public player statuses match supplied canonical views, including empty/waiting phases.
No faction, diagnostic, vote-private content, seed or chosen operation is exposed on player cards or HUD.
Lead/action availability derives from the service/local-engine view and no local deadline timer mutates authoritative phase.
Mobile/zoom layout reserves the banner and safe area, and a blocking overlay disables every underlying board/card/CTA.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: 8. Match: city board; RULES-SPEC-v1: 2. Win conditions, 3. Round state machine
